games.title: Rise & Shine
games.subtitle: 3D action fighter
games.desc: Fight your way through a very frum morning.

levels.title: 1 · Out of Bed
levels.desc: Beat the Yetzer Hara before he wins the snooze battle.

levels.title: 2 · Shul on Time
levels.desc: Run the street, smash the alarm clock, reach shul before davening starts.

levels.title: 3 · Davening in Shul
levels.desc: Put on tefillin, find your seat, stay quiet. No fighting here.

levels.title: 4 · Night Market
levels.desc: Knife and rifle imps. Buy a blaster!

levels.title: 5 · Seder Night
levels.desc: Boss fight at the Seder table. Find the Matzahs for a mega bomb.

levels.title: 6 · Purim Street
levels.desc: A long, crowded street. Reach the Purim Seudah in time.

levels.title: 7 · Final Round
levels.desc: The toughest Yetzer Hara. Collect Torah lights for the mega bomb.

howto.title: Your goal
howto.body: Rise & Shine is a 3D action game about a very frum morning. Beat the Yetzer Hara to get out of bed, run to shul on time, daven in peace, survive the night market and finish at the Seder. Finish each level to unlock the next one.

howto.title: Controls
howto.body: {controls}

howto.title: Fighting
howto.body: Punch is fast. Kick hits harder and farther. Jump over low attacks. Dodge makes you safe for a moment while you stay in place, so you can steer yourself with the controls while dodging. Enemies flash red or aim a red line right before they attack or shoot: that is your signal to dodge or move.

howto.title: Points, combos and the shop
howto.body: Every enemy you defeat gives points. Defeat several in a row within a few seconds to build a combo up to x5. Bosses are worth a lot. Spend points in the Shop on a blaster (SHOOT button, aims for you) and the rapid-fire upgrade.

howto.title: In the shul
howto.body: The shul level is not a fight. Walk around and look at the shul, pick up your tefillin (hold the action button), then sit in your seat. While davening: do not answer the phone, do not talk back to the person who talks to you and do not signal. Three mistakes and you lose.

howto.title: Mega bomb and camera
howto.body: In the Seder and Final Round levels, find 3 glowing items in the room. Collect all three to get a POWER UP (more health, faster, stronger) and a BOMB button. The bomb wipes out all the small Yetzer Haras and hurts the boss. In Settings > Game you can switch the camera to My eyes (first-person).

howto.title: The Yetzer Tov
howto.body: A glowing figure called the Yetzer Tov appears in the levels. Run to him and hold the action button to pray with him and heal, as long as nobody is hitting you. Use him when your health is low.

games.title: Street Runner
games.subtitle: 3D lane runner
games.desc: Sprint through the streets: dodge, jump, slide and grab coins.

levels.title: 1 · Erev Shabbos Dash
levels.desc: Race to shul before candle lighting. 900 m.

levels.title: 2 · Night Chase
levels.desc: Cars and buses. The Yetzer Hara is behind you. 1300 m.

howto.title: Your goal
howto.body: Street Runner is a lane runner. You run forward by yourself. Stay alive until the finish line at the shul. You have 3 lives. Crashing into something costs a life.

howto.title: Controls
howto.body: {runner_controls}

howto.title: Obstacles
howto.body: Crates, cars and buses block a lane: change lanes, or jump to land on top of crates and cars (not buses). You keep getting faster the longer you run. Get hit and the Yetzer Hara appears behind you: get hit again soon and he catches you. Red-and-white barriers are low: jump over them. Orange signs hang high: slide under them. In Night Chase, cars drive toward you, so move early.

howto.title: Coins and points
howto.body: Collect gold coins for points. You also earn points for distance and a bonus when you reach the finish. Points work in the Shop like in every other game.

games.title: Erev Shabbos City
games.subtitle: Open-world errands
games.desc: Drive a real family car and a motor boat through Jerusalem and Tiberias. Shop for Shabbos, load the trunk and reach shul before candle lighting.

levels.title: 1 · Geula & Machane Yehuda
levels.desc: Challah, fish, flowers, juice. Load the trunk, then shul. 5 minutes.

levels.title: 2 · Tiberias & the Kinneret
levels.desc: Drive to the marina, sail Moshe's boat for fresh fish, then the errands. 7 minutes.

howto.title: Your goal
howto.body: It is Erev Shabbos. Do the errands, carry everything home and reach the shul before candle lighting. The clock counts down and the sky turns to sunset. Level 2 is on the shore of the Kinneret in Tiberias: you even get a boat.

howto.title: On foot
howto.body: Left thumb: joystick to walk. Drag on the right side to look around; the camera turns with you. The yellow button appears when you can buy something, open the trunk, board the boat or get in the car.

howto.title: Carrying
howto.body: When you buy something you hold it up, then it goes into your shopping bag. A heavy bag slows you down. Walk to the back of your car and press PUT IN TRUNK. Before you go into shul, press TAKE OUT at the trunk to get the shopping back.

howto.title: Driving and sailing
howto.body: In a car or boat you get GAS and BRAKE pedals on the right. Hold brake when stopped to reverse. Steer with tilt, a slide bar, arrow buttons or a D-pad: pick your favourite in Settings > Game or in the pause menu. VIEW switches between chase, driver's seat and hood cameras. Look at the dashboard: the steering wheel really turns.

howto.title: Traps
howto.body: Bumping into people costs 1 second. Cars do not stop for you: getting hit costs 3 to 4 seconds. Chatty neighbours cost 8 seconds, so walk around them. Grab the gold shekels for bonus points.

games.title: Shtick Racing
games.subtitle: Boat and car races
games.desc: Race against the Yetzer Hara and his gang in boats and cars. Cliffs, dams, jumps and rapids, with a big steering wheel, gas, brake and a real gear shifter.

levels.title: 1 · Kinneret Cup
levels.desc: Boat race from Tiberias down the Jordan: rapids, a broken bridge and two dams. About 2 minutes.

levels.title: 2 · Geula Grand Prix
levels.desc: Car race, three laps through the streets and over a little bridge. About 2.5 minutes.

levels.title: 3 · Judean Hills Rally
levels.desc: Up the mountain, across a dam, down again. Hairpins and jumps. About 2 minutes.

levels.title: 4 · Jordan Canyon Marathon
levels.desc: The long boat race: four dams, four jumps and boost pads. About 5 minutes.

howto.title: Your goal
howto.body: Race five computer drivers. Finish in the top 3 to unlock the next race. Win to earn the most points. The Yetzer Hara is the fastest, so do not let him win.

howto.title: Steering
howto.body: Put your left thumb on the big steering wheel and turn it, like a real wheel. It springs back to the middle when you let go. You can change to arrow buttons or tilt in Options or in the pause menu.

howto.title: Gas, brake and gears
howto.body: Right thumb: GAS to go, BRAKE to slow down. The shifter has D (drive), N (neutral) and R (reverse). To back up, stop, slide the shifter down to R and press GAS. Tap AUTO to switch to MANUAL and pick gears 1 to 5 yourself: low gears pull hard, high gears are fast.

howto.title: Jumps, dams and boost
howto.body: Hit the yellow ramps fast to fly over the broken bridge. Yellow arrows on the road or water are boost pads. Boats slide on turns, so ease off the gas before a bend. If you fall off or get stuck, you are put back on the track by itself, or use Back on track in the pause menu.

howto.title: Camera and map
howto.body: VIEW switches between behind, high and the driver's seat. The map in the corner shows the whole course and where every racer is.

shop.name: Blaster
shop.desc: Shoot from a distance. Unlocks the SHOOT button.

shop.name: Iron Gloves
shop.desc: Fighter: punches and kicks hit 30% harder.

shop.name: Golden Blaster
shop.desc: Fighter: blaster shots do almost twice the damage.

shop.name: Coin Magnet
shop.desc: Runner: grab coins from twice as far.

tour.title: Welcome to Shtick Games
tour.body: This is your own game app. Games, themes and messages made just for you show up here by themselves.

tour.title: Play
tour.body: Pick a game and tap Play. Levels unlock one by one. Each game has a short How to play guide, and you can open it again any time from Settings.

tour.title: Points and the Shop
tour.body: Finish levels and defeat enemies to earn points. Spend them in the Shop, for example on the blaster that helps you shoot from far away.

tour.title: Alerts and help
tour.body: The bell at the top shows messages from us. If something goes wrong, open Settings and tap Report a problem. It sends us exactly what happened so we can fix it.
